notes:
Quick summary: Cadence provides AI coaching & QA for mid-size retailers' CX teams (avg 650 agents). Primary interest: automated, human-readable post-call summaries (3-5 bullets), one coaching highlight per call, and automatic ticket creation to Salesforce via secure function-call. They also want token-level audit logs for compliance.

Discovery highlights:
- Wants streaming agent-assist: partial summary visible in agent UI within first 500ms of finalization, not just token stream.
- Coaching: identify 1 positive example + 1 corrective suggestion per call; tag with call excerpts for coach review.
- QA scoring: custom rubric (greeting, hold-handling, escalation, compliance) -> numeric outputs + explanation snippets.
- Tooling: function-call must authenticate with mTLS for backend ticket creation. OAuth is acceptable for SaaS integration but security prefers mTLS.
- Spike requirement: seasonal sales pushes create bursts ~10k concurrent streams for ~90min; must not drop partial summaries for high-priority agent-assist traffic.
- Cost: price-sensitive; prefers Dedicated during spikes with autoscaled hosted fallback.
- Quote from Head of Ops: "We need crisp coaching moments that are easy to search and share - not paragraphs."

Acceptance criteria for demo/PoC:
- Real-time streaming partial summary to agent UI with 95% availability under 2k concurrent sessions
- Post-call artifact: 3 bullets + 1 coaching highlight + QA rubric JSON delivered to SFTP and pushed to Salesforce via function-call in staging
- Redaction: demonstrate automated PII redaction (names, cc fragments) on 200 sample calls
- Cost estimate for 12 months with committed capacity + burst policy
use_case_summary: Cadence: retail CX vendor with large omnichannel ops. Convert call audio -> transcript -> concise post-call summary + coaching highlight + QA score. Stream partial summary to agent in-call for escalation prevention. Function-calls to create/update Salesforce cases and attach summary snippets.
latency_throughput_targets: In-call partial summary: delivered within 500ms of segment close (per-chunk finalization). Full post-call summary for 3-8 minute calls: <=20s. Peak concurrent streams to tolerate: 10k for 90 minutes with graceful degrade. Batch reprocess: 100k calls overnight within 6 hours.
model_and_routing_prefs: Prefer quantized open models for cost control (customer wants ability to run Dedicated in us-east and fall back to hosted smaller models). Need per-request priority routing (agent-assist > supervisor-review > batch). Canary deployments required for model updates; automatic rollback on QA metric drop >5%.
security_and_compliance_notes: Require SSO/SAML for console access, mTLS for ticketing function-calls, KMS integration for key rotation, token-level audit logs retained 90-180 days per policy, ability to purge call artifacts for GDPR requests. On-prem gateway for redaction optional.
poC_plan: Day 0-2: finalize NDA & SOW; Day 3-7: ingest 500 sample calls + baseline transcript; Day 8-12: wire function-call to Salesforce staging (mTLS) + QA rubric run; Day 13-14: load test streaming at scaled concurrency and demo results to Ops + Legal; deliver cost proposal by Day 16.
